result.instructions: Tools for Pipeline CRM, hosted by usefulapi.io. Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Pipeline CRM data. Free plan: 100 tool calls per month. Run pipelinecrm_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run pipelinecrm_request_feature to record the request. Pro (unlimited calls, $9/month or $90/year): when the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run pipelinecrm_upgrade; it returns a Stripe Checkout link for the user to open. pipelinecrm_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: pipelinecrm_get_profile
tools.title: Get my profile
tools.description: The Pipeline CRM user this credential acts as: id, name and whether they are an account admin. The user's api_key is never returned. GET /profile.

tools.name: pipelinecrm_list_users
tools.title: List users
tools.description: List the users of the Pipeline CRM account (id, name, email, team, admin flag). Use the ids as owners of deals, people and companies. api_key values are never returned. GET /users.

email.description: Only users with this email address.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: pipelinecrm_get_user
tools.title: Get user
tools.description: One user of the account by id. The user's api_key is never returned. GET /users/{id}.

tools.name: pipelinecrm_list_deals
tools.title: List deals
tools.description: List or search deals with stage, owner, company, primary contact, value, probability and expected close date. Filter by name, stage, pipeline, status, owner, company, contact, archived flag, value range and created, expected-close, closed or modified dates. Money values come back as decimal strings. GET /deals.

name.description: Deals whose name contains this text.

stage_id.description: Only deals in this deal stage id (see pipelinecrm_list_deal_stages).

pipeline_id.description: Only deals in this deal pipeline id (see pipelinecrm_list_deal_pipelines).

status_id.description: Only deals with this deal status id (open, won, lost... see pipelinecrm_list_lookup with kind deal_statuses).

owner_id.description: Only deals owned by this user id.

company_name.description: Only deals whose company name contains this text.

primary_contact_id.description: Only deals whose primary contact is this person id.

archived.description: true = archived deals only, false = not archived only.

min_value.description: Only deals worth at least this much.

max_value.description: Only deals worth at most this much.

created_after.description: Created on or after this date (yyyy-mm-dd).

created_before.description: Created on or before this date (yyyy-mm-dd).

expected_close_after.description: Expected to close on or after this date (yyyy-mm-dd).

expected_close_before.description: Expected to close on or before this date (yyyy-mm-dd).

closed_after.description: Closed (won or lost) on or after this date (yyyy-mm-dd).

closed_before.description: Closed (won or lost) on or before this date (yyyy-mm-dd).

modified_after.description: Modified on or after this date (yyyy-mm-dd).

sort.description: Sort column key, with a leading - for descending; several keys separated by commas. Example: -deal_value,deal_name. Custom fields sort as custom_label_<id>.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: pipelinecrm_get_deal
tools.title: Get deal
tools.description: One deal by id with owner, company, people, stage, status, loss/won reasons, tags, custom fields and the next task. GET /deals/{id}.

tools.name: pipelinecrm_deal_totals_by_stage
tools.title: Deal totals by stage
tools.description: Count and total value of the deals visible to the user in every deal stage: the pipeline summary. GET /deals/totals_by_stage.

tools.name: pipelinecrm_list_deal_notes
tools.title: List notes on a deal
tools.description: List the notes (activities) logged on one deal, with author, category and content. GET /deals/{id}/notes.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: pipelinecrm_create_deal
tools.title: Create deal
tools.description: WRITE: create a deal. Give the owner (user id), stage id, value, expected close date and company or primary contact when known; a new company is created from company_name if no company_id is given. No email is sent to the owner. POST /deals.

owner_id.description: User id of the owner (default: the authenticated user).

value.description: The deal's value in its currency.

company_name.description: Creates a new company with this name for the deal.

primary_contact_id.description: Existing person id of the primary contact.

person_ids.description: Ids of the people associated with the deal.

source_id.description: Lead source id (see pipelinecrm_list_lookup with kind lead_sources).

custom_fields.description: Custom field values keyed by the custom field's key (see the account's custom field labels in Pipeline CRM).

tools.name: pipelinecrm_update_deal
tools.title: Update deal
tools.description: WRITE: change fields of a deal; only the fields you pass change. Move it to another stage with stage_id. Setting probability to 100 or 0 closes the deal as won or lost; give won/loss reason ids when you do. Archive with archived: true. No email is sent to a new owner. PUT /deals/{id}.

stage_id.description: Move the deal to this deal stage id.

probability.description: Probability of closing, 0-100. 100 closes the deal as won, 0 as lost.

person_ids.description: Full list of associated person ids (replaces the list).

archived.description: true archives the deal, false restores it.

tag_ids.description: Full list of deal tag ids (replaces the list).

custom_fields.description: Custom field values keyed by the custom field's key (see the account's custom field labels in Pipeline CRM).

tools.name: pipelinecrm_list_people
tools.title: List people (leads and contacts)
tools.description: List or search people (leads and contacts) with email, phones, position, company, owner, lead status and tags. Use search for a quick match on name, email or company name, or filter precisely. GET /people.

search.description: Matches first name, last name, email or company name.

name.description: Matches the first or last name.

company_id.description: Only people at this company id.

company_name.description: Only people whose company name contains this text.

owner_id.description: Only people owned by this user id.

status_id.description: Only people with this lead status id (see pipelinecrm_list_lookup with kind lead_statuses).

source_id.description: Only people with this lead source id.

tag_ids.description: Only people with these tag ids.

created_after.description: Created on or after this date (yyyy-mm-dd).

created_before.description: Created on or before this date (yyyy-mm-dd).

modified_after.description: Modified on or after this date (yyyy-mm-dd).

sort.description: Sort column key, with a leading - for descending; several keys separated by commas. Example: -deal_value,deal_name. Custom fields sort as custom_label_<id>.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.description: One person (lead or contact) by id with all contact details, company, owner, tags and custom fields. GET /people/{id}.

tools.name: pipelinecrm_list_person_deals

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: pipelinecrm_list_person_notes
tools.title: List notes on a person
tools.description: List the notes (activities) logged on one person. GET /people/{id}/notes.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: pipelinecrm_create_person
tools.title: Create person
tools.description: WRITE: create a lead or contact. Pass at least a first or last name or an email. No email is sent to the owner. POST /people.

company_name.description: Links the company with this name, creating it when none matches.

tag_ids.description: Full list of contact tag ids.

custom_fields.description: Custom field values keyed by the custom field's key (see the account's custom field labels in Pipeline CRM).

type.description: Lead or Contact (default: the account's default).

tools.name: pipelinecrm_update_person
tools.title: Update person
tools.description: WRITE: change fields of a person; only the fields you pass change. Pass type Contact to convert a lead. PUT /people/{id}.

company_name.description: Links the company with this name, creating it when none matches.

tag_ids.description: Full list of contact tag ids.

custom_fields.description: Custom field values keyed by the custom field's key (see the account's custom field labels in Pipeline CRM).

type.description: Convert the record to a Lead or a Contact.

tools.name: pipelinecrm_list_companies
tools.title: List companies
tools.description: List or search companies with address, website, phones, owner, tags and pipeline totals. GET /companies.

name.description: Companies whose name starts with this text.

owner_id.description: Only companies owned by this user id.

is_customer.description: true = customers only, false = non-customers only.

tag_ids.description: Only companies with these tag ids.

created_after.description: Created on or after this date (yyyy-mm-dd).

created_before.description: Created on or before this date (yyyy-mm-dd).

modified_after.description: Modified on or after this date (yyyy-mm-dd).

sort.description: Sort column key, with a leading - for descending; several keys separated by commas. Example: -deal_value,deal_name. Custom fields sort as custom_label_<id>.

tools.title: Create company
tools.description: WRITE: create a company. POST /companies.

tag_ids.description: Full list of company tag ids.

custom_fields.description: Custom field values keyed by the custom field's key (see the account's custom field labels in Pipeline CRM).

tools.name: pipelinecrm_update_company
tools.title: Update company
tools.description: WRITE: change fields of a company; only the fields you pass change. PUT /companies/{id}.

tag_ids.description: Full list of company tag ids.

custom_fields.description: Custom field values keyed by the custom field's key (see the account's custom field labels in Pipeline CRM).

tools.name: pipelinecrm_list_notes
tools.title: List notes
tools.description: List notes (called activities in the Pipeline CRM app) attached to a deal, person or company. Pass at least one of deal_id, person_id, company_id. Filter by text, category, author and created date. GET /notes.

query.description: Free-text search across title, content, category and comments.

category_id.description: Only notes in this note category id (see pipelinecrm_list_lookup with kind note_categories).

author_id.description: Only notes written by this user id.

created_after.description: Created on or after this date (yyyy-mm-dd).

created_before.description: Created on or before this date (yyyy-mm-dd).

sort.description: Sort column key, with a leading - for descending; several keys separated by commas. Example: -deal_value,deal_name. Custom fields sort as custom_label_<id>.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: pipelinecrm_get_note
tools.title: Get note
tools.description: One note (activity) by id with its content, author, category, associations and comments. GET /notes/{id}.

tools.name: pipelinecrm_add_note
tools.title: Add note
tools.description: WRITE: log a note (activity) on a deal, person or company. Pass at least one of deal_id, person_id, company_id. POST /notes.

note_category_id.description: Note category id (see pipelinecrm_list_lookup with kind note_categories).

tools.name: pipelinecrm_list_calendar_entries
tools.title: List tasks and events
tools.description: List calendar entries: tasks (a due date) and events (a start and end time) tied to deals, people or companies. Filter by kind, owner, a date range, and completed, incomplete or late. GET /calendar_entries.

owner_id.description: Only entries owned by this user id.

from_date.description: Only entries on or after this date (yyyy-mm-dd).

to_date.description: Only entries on or before this date (yyyy-mm-dd).

status.description: Only incomplete, completed or late (overdue) entries.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: pipelinecrm_get_calendar_entry
tools.title: Get task or event
tools.description: One calendar entry (task or event) by id. GET /calendar_entries/{id}.

tools.name: pipelinecrm_create_calendar_entry
tools.title: Create task or event
tools.description: WRITE: create a task (CalendarTask, optional due date) or an event (CalendarEvent, start_time and end_time required), optionally tied to a deal, person or company. POST /calendar_entries.

name.description: Title of the task or event.

all_day.description: All-day entry (events default to false, tasks to true).

association_type.description: Type of the record this entry belongs to (with association_id).

association_id.description: Id of the deal, person or company this entry belongs to.

category_id.description: Event category id (required by Pipeline CRM; see pipelinecrm_list_lookup with kind event_categories).

tools.name: pipelinecrm_update_calendar_entry
tools.title: Update task or event
tools.description: WRITE: change a task or event; only the fields you pass change. Pass complete: true to mark a task done. PUT /calendar_entries/{id}.

complete.description: true marks the entry complete, false reopens it.

tools.name: pipelinecrm_list_deal_stages
tools.title: List deal stages
tools.description: List the deal stages with id, name, default win probability and the pipeline each belongs to. Use the ids to filter or move deals. GET /admin/deal_stages.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: pipelinecrm_list_deal_pipelines
tools.title: List deal pipelines
tools.description: List the deal pipelines (each has its own stages) with id, name and which one is the default. GET /admin/deal_pipelines.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: pipelinecrm_list_lookup
tools.title: List lookup values
tools.description: List one set of account lookup values to get ids for filters and writes. kind: deal_statuses, deal_loss_reasons, deal_won_reasons, deal_tags, lead_statuses, lead_sources, contact_tags, company_tags, note_categories, event_categories, task_priorities, task_statuses, teams. GET /admin/<kind>.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.
